_about: What each boss says in battle (tools/voice/boss_lines.py records them; BossVoice plays them). Keys are game enemy ids. speaker = a cast.json voice; style = narrate.py STYLES (the battle styles are monsters: demon_*, torn, iron, herald_*, warden_*). Line kinds: arrive (first seen), taunt (while it strikes), heal, shield, bind (heal / barrier / binding or silencing towers), summon, fireball, destroy (a tower burnt down), enrage, hurt (half its life gone or its barrier broken), transform (a new form), flee, death. A kind a boss has no line for falls back to taunt. [tags] are ElevenLabs v3 acting directions. share = another boss whose lines this one uses.

arrive: [slowly] Two thousand years behind a door. [growls] Did you think I would knock?
taunt: Every stone you stand on was mine.
[laughs darkly] Kneel, and your city may keep its name.
destroy: [laughs darkly] Ash. Like the rest of them.
heal: My wounds close. Yours will not.
shield: Strike, little queen. I am older than your steel.
hurt: [snarling] You draw blood from a king?
transform: [roaring] You have not seen me. Not yet.

arrive: [roaring] Look at what your fathers made of me!
taunt: [growling] I will wear my crown over your skull.
hurt: [snarls] Is that all the six left you?
transform: [roaring] Then let there be nothing left of me!

arrive: [hoarse] There is no king left. Only the hunger.
taunt: [whispers] Do you hear it too?
fireball: [screaming] All of it! Burn all of it!
flee: [cold] This is not the end of the song.

arrive: Stand aside. I do this for my daughter, not for him.
taunt: You cannot win this, Spirewright.
Every life lost here will be paid back. I promised that.
heal: Not yet. I am not finished.
hurt: [pained] I have bled worse for less.
flee: [breathless] Fall back! This is not over.

arrive: [agonized] Ysolde... it burns. It burns and it will not stop.
taunt: [sobbing] I only wanted her back.
Fire, water, stone. I am all of it now.
heal: The stone mends me. It will not let me die.

arrive: [whispers] The sea gave me back. It kept everything else.
taunt: Come closer. The water is so cold, and so quiet.
I prayed to the tide for forty years. Now it answers only me.
heal: [softly] The tide returns what it takes.
bind: Drown, little towers. Drown and be still.
enrage: [screams] I will drag your city under!

arrive: [deep] I held the Kharum Pass for a month. I will hold this road forever.
taunt: Stone does not bleed. Stone does not tire.
Strike harder. The mountain is laughing.
shield: Stand fast. I am the wall now.
enrage: [roaring] Break! Break like the pass broke!

arrive: [sings softly] Hush now. The bells are ringing for you.
taunt: I sang at a thousand funerals. Yours will be my favourite.
[laughs softly] The dead are listening. Can you hear them hum?
heal: [humming] A song to close the wounds.
death: [whispers] The Marshal. It was the Marshal.

arrive: [breathless] I have a letter! I have to deliver the letter!
taunt: [manic laugh] I can't stop running. I can't stop burning!
Out of my way! The Marshal is waiting!
heal: The fire eats the hurt. It eats everything.
shield: Too hot to touch! Too hot!
enrage: [screaming] It hurts! Make it stop hurting!

arrive: [shouting] Ride with me, storm! One more charge!
taunt: I taught Kaela everything. Not everything I knew.
The sky is mine. Look up, and despair.
hurt: [grunts] Clean hit. She taught you well.
death: [weakly] Clean. The way I taught her.

arrive: [gently] Hush, children. Mother Briar is here to make it better.
taunt: Every thorn in me was planted with love.
[sweetly] Lie down in the roots. Sleep.

arrive: [roaring] Who wakes the fire? The fire is hungry!
taunt: I was a king of flame. Now I am only flame.
[growling] The whisper says burn. So I burn.
heal: Ash to ember. Ember to blaze.

arrive: [whispers] Be still, the voice said. [shouting] We will not be still!
taunt: We are the wind that tore your roofs away.
Two voices. One storm.
shield: The eye of the storm. Calm. Untouchable.

arrive: [tired] So many children. All of them hungry.
taunt: Grow. Grow and devour.
[weary laugh] I am so old, and I cannot stop growing.
enrage: [shrieking] My children! You hurt my children!
death: [relieved] One seed left. Plant it far from here.

arrive: [echoing] I remember every ship that sank in me.
taunt: I will remember you too. Every scream.
The tide is rising, and it does not forgive.
shield: Below the waves, nothing can touch me.
hurt: [groaning] An old wound. I remember it.
death: [whispers] I will tell you what we did.

arrive: [very slowly] Two thousand years... of silence.
taunt: Small things. Loud things.
The mountain does not move. You move.

arrive: The crown is heavy. The crown is mine. [whispers] Help me.
taunt: I hear what walks beneath your land.
[laughs darkly] Fight it? I am it.
shield: The void wraps me. Cold. Safe.
death: [whispers] Not yet. I am still in here.
